title: 第九章 人外有人
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
很快，秦天就得到系统的提示，对方已经成功交易了兽栏给他。

    【兽栏：可驯化凶兽野兽，转换为己方领地阵营单位】

    【当前可容纳上限：3】

    看到这描述，秦天下意识就挑了挑眉毛。

    果然如他所想的那样，这玩意儿不能从名字来判断，不仅仅是领民搭建一个兽栏这么简单，这玩意儿居然可以把凶兽和野兽进行驯化。

    野兽也就罢了，毕竟人类确实是有驯养先例的，凶兽也是能驯化的吗？

    这玩意儿，好像只有在这个全民领主的世界里才有吧？

    无论是实力还是攻击性，都是很高的。

    这种玩意儿，现在普通的领主遇到，恐怕连安全都没有保障，能不能正常发育都是问题，更别说将其驯养了。

    但是，这个兽栏就可以？

    看样子，这也是其他玩家觉醒出来的那些天赋，所生产出来的东西？

    这么看来，或许有的天赋，本身并没有什么太大的问题，只是不那么适合战斗，在前期要想发展自己的领地，比较困难。

    又或者说，他们觉醒出的这些天赋更加偏向传统认知里，生活创造类以及辅助一类的这种职业。

    同时，他的心里也冒出了一些新的想法。

    除了本来自己领地当中的这些物件，会不会也可以对玩家所创造出来的这些东西，进行相应的升级呢？

    如果这也能进化，那可就太好了！

    想到这里，秦天的心都不由得稍微激动了起来。

    不过同时，秦天的表情上确实不露半分，只是在确认交易成功以后，就点了点头。

    “这是你自主选择赠送的？不需要领主币？”

    末了，秦天又忽然冷不丁冒出这么一句。

    他看得出来，眼前这个人，明显因为他毫发无伤，击杀凶兽的事情，而被吓得不轻，所以现在会有这样的反应。

    在面对他的时候，明显是有些慌乱的，多多少少带着点害怕。
content_en:
Soon, Qin Tian received a notification from the system that the other party had successfully traded the animal pen to him.

    [Beast Stable: Ferocious beasts can be tamed and converted into units of your own territory and camp]

    [Current capacity limit: 3]

    Seeing this description, Qin Tian raised his eyebrows subconsciously.

    Sure enough, as he thought, this thing cannot be judged from the name. It is not just as simple as the leader building a stable. This thing can actually tame ferocious beasts and beasts.

    Just wild beasts. After all, humans do have domestication precedents. Can ferocious beasts also be tamed?

    This thing seems to only exist in this world of universal lords, right?

    Both strength and aggressiveness are very high.

    If ordinary lords encounter this kind of thing now, their safety may not even be guaranteed, and whether it can develop normally is a problem, let alone domesticating it.

    But, is this animal pen okay?

    It seems that this is also something produced by the talents awakened by other players?

    From this point of view, perhaps some talents do not have any big problems in themselves, but they are not suitable for fighting. It is more difficult to develop one's own territory in the early stage.

    In other words, the talents they awakened are more inclined towards the traditional cognition of life creation and support occupations.

    At the same time, some new ideas emerged in his mind.

    In addition to the objects originally in your own territory, will it be possible to upgrade the objects created by players accordingly?

    It would be great if this could evolve too!

    Thinking of this, Qin Tian couldn't help but feel a little excited.

    But at the same time, Qin Tian's expression did not reveal anything. He just nodded after confirming that the transaction was successful.

    "Is this a gift of your own choice? No need for lord coins?"

    Finally, Qin Tian suddenly said this out of nowhere.

    He could see that the man in front of him was obviously frightened because he was unharmed and killed the beast, so he reacted like this now.

    When facing him, he was obviously a little flustered and more or less afraid.
